title: YouTube fan funding (expanded YPP)
one_liner: From 500 subscribers, fans can pay you through memberships, Super Thanks, Super Chat and Shopping.
pay: Fan payments and Shopping commissions; YouTube publishes no fixed rate. Ad revenue unlocks later at 1,000 subscribers + 4,000 watch hours (12 months) or 10M Shorts views (90 days).
steps: Post 3 valid public uploads in 90 days.
Get 3,000 watch hours in 12 months or 3M Shorts views in 90 days.
Turn on 2-Step Verification, link one AdSense account and apply.
catch: Only in eligible countries; review takes about a month; no ad revenue share at this tier.
sources: YouTube Help: expanded YouTube Partner Program

match.first_step: Post 3 public uploads this month and track your watch hours.
